notes: This episode covers overlapping storylines involving Sylwester Wardenga, Katarzyna Meciński, Aniela Olszewska, Jakub Łysiak, Daria Dąbrowska, and Hanna Koczewska. The pre-existing draft was already fairly thorough (only 5 Rule C misses initially), but a full manual read-through of the entire transcript found roughly 85 further real mentions Rule C could not catch on its own -- overwhelmingly inflected forms and phonetic typos of the core names, plus many multi-line surname splits caused by short caption lines. Two false-positive risks were carefully disambiguated: at [00:19] and [01:17]/[01:19] the literal text is 'Krzysztofa Stanowskiego' (a different person from Krzysztof Gonciarz), so the exact_mention was corrected to the full compound / a proper multi-line pair for Krzysztof Stanowski (id 69) rather than letting the ambiguous first name spill over onto Gonciarz. A garbled typo 'Karolina doarka' was recognized as 'Karolina Domaracka' from context. Numerous 'Gonciarz' phonetic variants were found scattered throughout ('gociarz', 'kończarza', 'skąciarze', 'Konciarza'), consistent with the heavy ASR corruption of this surname seen across the series. Several timestamp errors introduced during the manual-addition process (including two further multi-line splits discovered only after re-validating) were caught and corrected by repeatedly re-running the validator rather than treating any single pass as final.
